title: Master Supply Agreement
review_scope: Targeted review of sections material to the Tradeopedia model; not a full legal opinion or complete contract audit

related_documents.name: Separation and Distribution Agreement
related_documents.reason: Articles VII and 10.2 incorporated by reference

findings.label: Parties and supply roles
findings.finding: 3M is Supplier and Solventum is Purchaser.
findings.limitation: Contractual roles do not establish the actual importer of record.

findings.label: Cross-border delivery terms
findings.finding: Cross-border shipments use FCA port of export (Incoterms 2020), unless otherwise agreed.
findings.limitation: Delivery risk allocation is not identical to statutory customs liability.

findings.label: Price adjustment
findings.finding: Taxes and additional amounts are invoiced to Purchaser; price changes include defined production cost drivers.
findings.limitation: No general automatic tariff pass-through conclusion is drawn.

findings.label: Commercial shipping documents
findings.finding: Invoices and related shipping documents must identify orders, items, quantities, prices, and purchaser identifier when provided.
findings.limitation: Not equivalent to full customs recordkeeping cooperation.

findings.label: Inspection rights
findings.finding: Purchaser may inspect products and manufacturing facilities subject to notice and cost terms.
findings.limitation: Not necessarily a customs audit right.

findings.label: Supplier indemnity
findings.finding: Supplier indemnifies Purchaser for specified damages connected with Supplier breach, subject to exceptions.
findings.limitation: Read alongside Article 11 and referenced Separation and Distribution Agreement.

findings.label: Purchaser indemnity
findings.finding: Purchaser has broad third-party claim indemnity obligations with specified exceptions.
findings.limitation: Applicability to a particular government claim needs legal analysis.

findings.label: Limitations and notice
findings.finding: Certain damages are excluded; supplier liability is generally capped using annual product price, with carve-outs and an additional cross-agreement cap.
findings.limitation: Section 11.2(b) also has a short notice period; enforceability and exceptions not determined.

findings.label: IOR and customs allocation
findings.finding: Purchaser must comply with customs requirements if it acts as IOR; Supplier disclaims stated clearance-delay and inaccurate-declaration costs and penalties.
findings.limitation: Does not establish Solventum actually acted as IOR in any shipment or override CBP duties.

findings.label: Export and restricted-party controls
findings.finding: Purchaser undertakes specified licensing, destination, end-user, sanctions and antiboycott obligations.
findings.limitation: Requires transaction- and time-specific legal review.

findings.label: Trade compliance remedies
findings.finding: Materiality, potential immediate termination, investigation cooperation, and indemnification follow certain trade-compliance breaches.
findings.limitation: Scope and interaction with caps require further legal analysis.

findings.label: Dispute-resolution incorporation
findings.finding: Dispute escalation and resolution are incorporated from the Separation and Distribution Agreement; governing law and jurisdiction are also incorporated.
findings.limitation: Do not classify as arbitration or litigation until incorporated SDA provisions are examined.

findings.label: CISG applicability
findings.finding: No conclusion is reached about CISG exclusion or application.
findings.limitation: Examine incorporated choice-of-law clause and transaction facts first.

findings.label: Country-of-origin warranty
findings.finding: No validated finding yet on a standalone country-of-origin warranty.
findings.limitation: Do not equate not determined with absent.

findings.label: Tariff-specific adjustment
findings.finding: No validated finding yet on a tariff-specific change-in-law or duty adjustment mechanism.
findings.limitation: Review incorporated documents and full pricing structure.
